commit_message: Fix Goose managed-local ACP isolation and leases
pr_title: Add Goose Managed Local ACP adapter
pr_body:
## Summary
- add the Goose-specific ACP adapter on the ACP Foundation baseline
- isolate Goose under a per-session `GOOSE_PATH_ROOT` with an ephemeral secretless custom OpenAI-compatible provider targeting the Managed Local endpoint
- acquire/release the existing ManagedLocalRuntime endpoint lease on the worker thread and prevent cross-environment/same-root server replacement while leased
- pass the existing GameEngine MCP HTTP endpoint through ACP with read-only or AgentRun-bound headers
- fail closed on unclassified Goose permission requests and surface unknown ACP updates as diagnostics
- pin the ACP Rust SDK API version and keep Goose/Managed Local/GGUF runtime identity correlated

## Scope
This is the Goose Local ACP parallel authoring subtask only. It does not remove the native agent loop, change Hosted API/Codex/Claude, wire final AI Studio provider selection, or change project/scene/asset serialization.

## Baseline
Built on ACP Foundation HEAD `694de8724308c3acdd171fd9e2293876821f86ee` (Draft PR #1037).

## Validation
Per the parallel-authoring protocol, heavy cargo validation, Windows Validation, and Visual Validation are deferred to final integration. Unit-test code is present but not executed here. Canonical request build/preflight, exact-head checking, patch applicability, path policy, and whitespace preflight remain required.
